<div class="card-body">
'''Disarmed (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">切断された腕</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">武器を持ったキャラクターが、敵味方共に同じ位置にいる場合に使う。支配フェイズ（敵の支配フェイズでも可）に配備する。敵キャラクターは武器を失い、戦闘力－１になる。さらに、これ以降、武器を配備できなくなる。「意識操作」の影響を受けない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-214o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">Ｃ－３ＰＯの腕は、タスケン・レイダーの襲撃でもげてしまった。「これ以上は無理です。行って下さい、ルーク様。私はもうだめです…」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Severed Arm.

'''Card text:''' Use when both sides have a character with a weapon at the same location. Deploy during either player's control phase. The opposing character loses its weapon, is power −1, and cannot have weapons deployed on it thereafter. Immune to Alter.

'''Lore:''' C-3PO's arm came off during a Tusken Raider attack. “I can't go on. Please go, Master Luke. I'm done for…”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Disarmed (Dark)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
